effectgroup.name: OuzFX AFX_Move_Bounce_Drop_Out
effectgroup.description: Mirror of 'Anim · Bounce In (Drop)': a few growing hops on the floor, then it launches out of the top (20 frames, bounce ease-in). Razor 20 frames before the end of the clip and drop it on that last piece – the layer is gone on the last frame (anything after stays hidden).
